findings.area: agenda row · Copa del Rey (CD Baztán, CD Tedeón, Ceuta 6 de Junio)
findings.issue: Round/meta text is in English ("2nd Leg - Atlético Calatayud lead 2-0 on aggregate") while every other UI string on the page is Norwegian. Same on 375/393. Likely comes straight from the football.json fetcher output, not the frontend template, so it may not be fixable in docs/js/ alone.

notes: All three widths: single quiet column, generous spacing, no horizontal scroll or clipped text at 375px (the hardest case) — team names wrap onto a second line instead of truncating, so nothing hides which side is playing.
Norge – Portugal and Wales – Norge both show TV 2 Direkte / TV 2 Play, correctly Norwegian, with an accent dot for the must-see Norway fixtures; no foreign broadcasters (FOX/ESPN/Sky) seen anywhere.
Rows with no confirmed channel show an honest faint '–' (CF San Rafael – AE Prat, CP Talayuela – Sporting de Alcázar, the Copa del Rey legs, Gulf Air Bahrain GP) rather than a guess or blank space.
Flags/crests (Norge, Wales, Bergen Håndball badge) and sport glyphs (golf flag, cycling, F1 helmet) all render as real icons, no broken-image boxes.

Multi-day events (Presidents Cup, FedEx Open de France, Alfred Dunhill Links Championship, Bank of Utah Championship) show a date range instead of a single time — correct handling of the isEventInWindow-style span.

The floating 'Assistent' button rests over a mid-agenda row (Runar Elite – Viking TIF area) at 375/393, and sits in the empty margin beside the 640px column at 900px with no overlap — matches the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom in both cases, not flagged. It does not cover the last agenda row (Bryne – Lyn) or the footer at any width.
Header, 'I DAG'/'TORSDAG'/'LØRDAG'/'SØNDAG' day headings, and footer (Oppdatert-stamp, Abonner i kalender, Aktivitet, Personvern, AI-budsjett line) are all intact and aligned at every width.
Direkte nå chess rows and 'Neste opp' player list render cleanly with right-aligned status text ('pågår nå').
